nothing_read_body: Build the model to read the documents.
howto_more: Pick a layer, then a card: what it holds, how it relates and which passages say so. Missing a relation? A document has to declare it; the model reads it on the next build.
left_out: Left out: {n} words that are not things the product has — identifiers such as ADR-0007 or cpt-…, a word used once in passing, what a kit's templates and examples say. They stay in Requirements and the Glossary.
none_only: No entity in this layer is {what}.
none_matches: No entity in this layer matches.
legend_relation: a relation a document declares, named by its verb
legend_zoom: scroll to zoom · drag to move
unpin_title: Unpin: the panel follows the pointer again
not_related_yet: Not related yet: no document declares how these connect to the rest
edit_title: Correct what it is, what it holds or how it relates
accept_all_title: Accept every reading of it still proposed, in one action
no_relation_in_layer: No relation is declared in this layer yet.
cut_unrelated: related to nothing: a document has to declare how
cut_unkept: kept by no gear of the product
point_at_row: Point at a row to see it here; click it to keep it.
read_next_build: The model reads it on its next build.
editor_where: Saved to docs/domain-model.md in the project's repository, one section per entity. The model reads it on its next build.
